package postgres_test

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestOnboardingPlanHandoffMigrationIsReceiptOnlyAndFailClosed(t *testing.T) {
	up, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/009_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(up)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff", "UNIQUE (student_id, idempotency_key)",
		"UNIQUE (student_id, state_ref_kind, state_ref_version)", "request_hash", "dialog_id", "teacher_job_id",
		"NOT_STARTED", "NOT_CREATED", "readiness_observed_at", "CHECK (created_at >= readiness_observed_at)",
		"protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff", "BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE",
		"protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate", "BEFORE TRUNCATE", "FOR EACH STATEMENT", "BEGIN;", "COMMIT;",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"course_plan_request", "planner_outbox", "course_id", "learning_path_id", "lesson_id"} {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(migration), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected S9 state %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/009_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff.down.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(down), "cannot remove teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff while immutable handoff evidence exists") ||
		!strings.Contains(string(down), "LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE") ||
		!strings.Contains(string(down), "DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate") ||
		!strings.Contains(string(down), "DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff") ||
		!strings.Contains(string(down), "DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate()") ||
		!strings.Contains(string(down), "DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff()") ||
		!strings.Contains(string(down), "DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff") {
		t.Fatal("down migration must fail closed before dropping receipt evidence")
	}
}
